papers.title: Unifying bright spots research for people and nature
papers.abstract: This Review presents a typology for how to identify and interpret bright spots, or positive deviance, in conservation and sustainability science—cases where unexpectedly positive outcomes occur despite local constraints.
papers.titleZh: 統一亮點研究：人與自然的正向偏差
papers.summaryZh: 這篇綜述提出一套用於辨識與詮釋亮點、即正向偏差的類型學，聚焦於保育與永續科學領域。亮點指的是在地方限制下仍出現出乎意料正面結果的案例。作者整理如何系統性地找出這類案例並進行詮釋的方法框架。該類型學旨在為保育與永續研究提供統一的研究視角。

papers.title: Interaction matrices as unifying tools for navigating ecological complexity
papers.abstract: The interaction matrix is a widely used tool in community ecology. In this Review, the authors outline this approach and discuss how to tackle its challenges.
papers.titleZh: 互動矩陣作為導航生態複雜性的統一工具
papers.summaryZh: 本文為《Nature Ecology & Evolution》的一篇綜述，指出互動矩陣是群落生態學中廣泛使用的工具。作者概述此方法並討論如何應對其挑戰。

papers.title: Behind (cell) walls
papers.abstract: While mammalian delivery technologies are advancing to translation at an exceptional rate, delivery to plant tissues faces challenges, limiting their practical applications.

papers.title: Discovery and engineering of avian R2 retrotransposons for all-RNA-mediated targeted DNA integration in human cells
papers.abstract: Engineered retrotransposons enable site-specific DNA integration into human cells.
papers.titleZh: 改造鳥類 R2 逆轉錄轉座子實現全 RNA 介導的人類細胞定點 DNA 整合
papers.summaryZh: 該研究報導了鳥類 R2 逆轉錄轉座子的發現與工程化，以用於全 RNA 介導的人類細胞定點 DNA 整合。研究指出經工程化的逆轉錄轉座子可在人類細胞中實現位點特異性的 DNA 整合。該工作以 Nature Biotechnology 發表。結果顯示此類工程化逆轉錄轉座子提供了一種以 RNA 為基礎的定點整合策略。

papers.title: Detectrons convert transient RNA sequences into stable DNA barcodes for high-throughput analysis of RNA-dependent processes
papers.abstract: RNA sequences are detected and converted directly into DNA barcodes.
papers.titleZh: Detectrons 將短暫 RNA 序列轉為穩定 DNA 條碼
papers.summaryZh: 本研究提出 Detectrons，可將短暫的 RNA 序列直接偵測並轉換為穩定的 DNA 條碼。該方法提供一種將 RNA 訊號轉為 DNA 形式的方式。作者指出此轉換可用於高通量分析 RNA 依賴性過程。透過將易變的 RNA 訊號穩定化為 DNA 條碼，有助於後續的高通量分析。

papers.abstract: Evolution of nutrient cross-feeding between a yeast and oomycete mediates microbial coexistence and leaf microbiome stability.
papers.titleZh: 硫胺素互補餵養驅動葉片微生物群共存
papers.summaryZh: 該研究指出，葉片微生物群中存在硫胺素互補餵養現象，並與微生物共存有關。摘要提到，酵母與卵菌之間演化出營養互補餵養，能調節微生物共存並影響葉片微生物群的穩定性。論文標題強調硫胺素互補餵養在葉片微生物群共存中的作用。研究發表於《Nature Microbiology》。

papers.title: Uracil-driven ROS signaling and larval TrpA1-B neuron activation are required for priming the adult Drosophila gustatory response to bacteria
papers.abstract: Animals perceive their immediate environment through their sensory systems. While these systems rely on well-defined neuronal circuits and receptor proteins encoded by the genome, they can also be modulated by internal physiological conditions or exogenous factors. We have previously shown that the presence of certain pathogenic bacteria in the larval gut can alter the specificity of bacterial peptidoglycan recognition in the adults that emerge from these larvae. However, the nature of the bacterial signal and the host cells and molecules involved in receiving and transducing this signal remained unknown. Our results identify uracil as the bacterial metabolite responsible for this priming and demonstrate that the effect is mediated by Duox-dependent production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in the larval gut. We further show that specific expression of TrpA1 isoforms in a Gr66a-expressing neuron of the larval terminal organ is required for the adult response. Together, these findings reveal uracil as the bacterial cue and the Duo/ROS signaling and TrpA1/Gr66a modules as key mediators linking larval gut microbial signals and host integration to subsequent sensory system modulation in the adult.
papers.titleZh: 尿嘧啶驅動的 ROS 訊息傳遞與幼蟲 TrpA1-B 神經元活化，為啟動成蟲 Drosophila（果蠅）對細菌味覺反應之所需
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討了幼蟲期接觸細菌如何調節成蟲的感官反應，並指出細菌代謝產物尿嘧啶是此一啟動效應的關鍵訊號。研究結果顯示，此效應是由幼蟲腸道中雙氧化酶（Duox）依賴性的活性氧類（ROS）產生所介導。此外，幼蟲終端器官中表現 Gr66a 的神經元上特定 TrpA1 亞型的表現，對於成蟲的反應亦不可或缺。這些發現揭示了尿嘧啶作為細菌訊號，以及相關訊息傳遞模組如何將幼蟲腸道微生物訊號與宿主整合，進而調節成蟲的感覺系統。

papers.title: Integrated multi-omics analysis reveals the molecular landscape and therapeutic strategies in Chinese cervical cancer patients
papers.abstract: Genomic or transcriptomic sequencing guides the precision of cervical cancer (CC) diagnosis; however, the molecular profile of Asian patients remains poorly understood. We established a comprehensive multi-omics cohort comprising 112 tumor-normal adjacent tissue pairs from Chinese CC patients. Our integrated analysis revealed a mutational burden comparable to other populations, with three major mutational signatures primarily attributed to APOBEC-associated, age-associated, and DNA repair-associated biological categories. Multi-omics profiling elucidated the functional consequences of somatic mutations and copy number variations, identifying PIK3CA, EP300, and MPRIP as key driver events. We further uncovered both concordant and discordant activation patterns across cancer-related signaling pathways. Transcriptomic and proteomic analyses nominated cell cycle regulation, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and LAMC2 as promising diagnostic and therapeutic targets. Comprehensive immune characterization enabled stratification of patients into three major immune phenotypes with varying microenvironmental profiles. This study provides valuable resources and novel insights into the molecular architecture of cervical cancer in the Chinese population, identifying potential biomarkers to guide precision detection and immunotherapy strategies.
papers.titleZh: 整合多體學解析中國子宮頸癌分子圖譜與治療策略
papers.summaryZh: 本研究建立了包含112對中國子宮頸癌患者腫瘤與鄰近正常組織的多體學隊列。整合分析顯示其突變負擔與其他族群相當，並發現三種主要突變特徵，分別與APOBEC相關、年齡相關及DNA修復相關的生物學類別有關。多體學分析闡明了體細胞突變與拷貝數變異的功能後果，指出PIK3CA、EP300與MPRIP為關鍵驅動事件。轉錄組與蛋白質體分析提出細胞週期調控、上皮-間質轉化及LAMC2為潛在的診斷與治療標靶。全面免疫特徵分析將患者分為三種主要免疫表型，其微環境特徵各異。

papers.title: Moral and perceptual conflict processing are implemented by distinct brain activation and functional connectivity patterns
papers.abstract: While humans resemble other primates in terms of motor and perceptual abilities, our behavior is uniquely characterized by morality—the ability to choose our actions based on specific ethical values. The evolutionary origins and neurobiological basis of moral behavior are debated intensely, with opposing proposals about whether moral decisions rely on domain-general decision-making neural circuitry (neural common currency hypothesis) or on unique neural processes that were shaped by evolutionary pressures associated with life in groups (social brain hypothesis). Here we examine the potential overlap between moral and perceptual decision-making, by combining functional magnetic resonance imaging with computational modeling of behavior in a novel task requiring human participants to make alternating moral and perceptual choices on identical stimuli. At the algorithmic level, we found that moral and perceptual choices were well fit by the same sequential sampling model, which allowed us to quantify and directly compare conflicts between the choice alternatives for both types of decision-making. At the implementational level, moral and perceptual choice conflicts were represented by distinct neural activity patterns; in fact, neural signals in some brain areas (e.g., temporoparietal junction) encoded the strength of the two types of conflict in opposite directions. Our findings suggest that while similar computational decision mechanisms underlie both moral and perceptual choices, their neural implementation is fundamentally different, supporting the social brain hypothesis.
papers.titleZh: 道德與知覺衝突處理由不同腦區活化與功能連結模式實現
papers.summaryZh: 本研究以功能性磁振造影結合計算模型，探討人類在相同刺激下交替進行道德與知覺選擇時的決策機制。演算法層面顯示，道德與知覺選擇皆能以相同的序列取樣模型良好擬合，使研究者得以量化並直接比較兩類決策的選擇衝突。實施層面則發現，道德與知覺選擇的衝突由不同的神經活動模式代表，部分腦區例如顳頂交界處對兩種衝突強度的編碼方向相反。結果顯示道德與知覺選擇雖共享相似的計算決策機制，但其神經實現方式根本不同，支持社會腦假說。

papers.title: Why are some neurons spared in neurodegeneration? Cellular subtype identity maintenance as a candidate threshold-setting mechanism
papers.abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases often damage some neuronal populations while sparing closely related neighbors. But instead of asking why some neurons die, should we be asking why some survive? This Essay proposes that a neuron’s capacity to sustain the gene-regulatory machinery that maintains its subtype identity helps set the stress threshold beyond which recovery fails. The initiating insult may be metabolic, proteostatic, inflammatory, or arise from the surrounding tissue, but it is the cell’s capacity for maintenance that will determine where the tipping point lies: above a critical level, the identity program recovers, whereas below it, regulatory loss becomes self-sustaining. Such a framing could have implications for how neuronal vulnerability to neurodegeneration is understood.
papers.titleZh: 神經退化中部分神經元被保留的原因：細胞亞型身份維持作為閾值設定機制
papers.summaryZh: 這篇刊載於 PLOS Biology 的 Essay 提出，神經退化疾病常損害某些神經元族群，卻保留相近的鄰近細胞。作者建議與其問為何某些神經元死亡，不如問為何某些神經元存活。文中提出，神經元維持其亞型身份的基因調控機制能力，可能有助於設定壓力超過後無法恢復的閾值。起始傷害可能是代謝、蛋白質穩態、發炎或來自周圍組織，但細胞的維持能力將決定轉折點所在。超過臨界水平時身份程序可恢復，低於該水平時調控喪失會變成自我維持。此框架可能影響對神經元易受神經退化影響脆弱性的理解。

papers.title: Fast single molecule localization microscopy in 3D
papers.abstract: Super-resolution methods, such as single molecule localisation microscopy (SMLM), can determine the distribution of specific proteins at the nanometre scale. However, three-dimensional (3D) SMLM is typically limited to thin sections and requires prohibitively long acquisition times to image complete cells. Here we introduce a 3D SMLM imaging modality, Intrinsic3D, that combines the speed and optical sectioning of oblique plane microscopy (OPM) with the nanometre resolution of SMLM to determine the position of single molecule emitters throughout complete volumes more than an order-of-magnitude faster over regular DNA-PAINT. By scanning the oblique light sheet across the volume and combining localization information from two or more adjacent planes, an emitter's x, y and z position is determined, eliminating the need for post-processing steps to stitch multiple image stacks together. We demonstrate resolution and speed by imaging nuclear pore complexes in U2OS cells and Drosophila egg chambers. As a proof-of-concept, we map the 3D distribution of the cell-adhesion protein DE-cadherin in the Drosophila follicular epithelium and show that spot adherens junctions are enriched near tricellular junctions and contain more E-cadherin than the apical adherens junctions, suggesting that spot junctions play a wider role in cell-cell adhesion than previously appreciated. Finally, we examine the organization of Gliotactin, a tricellular septate junction protein relative to E-cadherin using exchange-PAINT. These investigations demonstrate that Intrinsic3D delivers rapid 3D protein mapping in whole cells. Combining Intrinsic3D with existing multiplex and resolution enhancing methods (e.g. exchange-PAINT and RESI) will enable multicolour, 3D in situ spatial proteomics in tissue samples and bridge the gap between SMLM and systems-level cell biology.
papers.titleZh: 三維快速單分子定位顯微鏡

papers.title: An amyloid-β/APP regulatory layer in human brown adipocyte recruitment identifies repurposable drugs for thermogenic fat expansion
papers.abstract: Brown adipose tissue (BAT) increases energy expenditure but is scarce in adults, yet most strategies focus on activating existing thermogenic adipocytes rather than recruiting new ones. We integrate human single-nucleus transcriptomics with protein-interaction and knowledge-graph analyses to identify stage-specific, druggable programmes governing brown adipogenesis. This pipeline resolved four ordered transcriptional states and three transitions, revealing an amyloid-{beta}/APP regulatory layer and nominating APP as a central signalling hub. Most prioritised compounds altered differentiation or metabolic phenotype, several substantially. Phenserine (APP-lowering) and sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) promoted differentiation through distinct mechanisms and stages and could be combined sequentially for benefit. Phenserine increased differentiation across three human models and, in mice, expanded BAT mass and increased thermogenic capacity. Together, these findings reveal targetable control points in human brown adipocyte recruitment, nominate repurposable drugs for BAT expansion, and establish a generalisable framework coupling single-cell transcriptomics with network-based drug repurposing across staged biological systems.
papers.titleZh: 人類棕色脂肪細胞招募中澱粉樣-β/APP 調控層揭示可再利用藥物促進產熱脂肪擴張

papers.title: A regenerative fibroblast competence field supports multiple cell fates in adult skin regeneration
papers.abstract: Adult mammalian wounds typically restore tissue integrity through fibrotic repair rather than regeneration of the original architecture. Here, we compared small non-regenerative and large regenerative skin wounds to investigate how fibroblasts acquire regenerative competence and enter alternative cell-fate programs. Integrated single-cell RNA sequencing identified a transient signaling and extracellular-matrix-remodeling niche enriched in large wounds, together with NCAM1-associated competent fibroblast states. Time-resolved analysis positioned these states within a root-like fibroblast manifold connected to hair dermal-condensate, endothelial, pericyte and glial-associated fate-entry programs. Inferred cell-cell communication networks revealed shared matrix and adhesion signals, superimposed with branch-associated inputs, including VEGF signaling toward NCAM1-positive endothelial-transition cells. Lineage tracing showed that PDGFRA- and NCAM1-expressing lineages contributed to vascular- and nerve/glial-associated regenerative compartments. Functionally, partial NCAM1 perturbation reduced vascular organization while increasing hair follicle neogenesis, whereas stronger inhibition impaired both outcomes. These findings identify NCAM1 as a regulator of regenerative competence and fate specification within a regenerative competence field rather than a marker of a single terminal lineage. We propose that regenerative wounds activate an NCAM1-associated fibroblast competence field whose quantitative modulation biases competent fibroblasts toward alternative outcomes.

papers.title: EndoMT: An R Package Resource for Endothelial-Mesenchymal Transition Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
papers.abstract: Introduction: Endothelial-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT) is a dynamic endothelial cell-state transition increasingly implicated in fibrosis, vascular dysfunction, inflammation and cancer. Despite expansion of EndoMT-focused transcriptomic research, EndoMT representation remains limited to broader epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) frameworks in standard gene set repositories. Methods: To address the absence of a general-purpose EndoMT gene set for transcriptomic enrichment analysis, we developed an open EndoMT gene set resource and accompanying R package. A literature-informed EndoMT gene set was curated and directionally assigned to EndoMT UP and EndoMT DOWN signatures according to reported or hypothesised expression during partial EndoMT, defined here as an active transitional state rather than a complete mesenchymal endpoint, to improve capture of EndoMT-associated transcriptional changes across different stages of the process. Genes were annotated by marker subtype and implemented as Gene Matrix Transposed files distributed through the R package, together with exported R objects and gene-level metadata. Benchmarking was performed using bulk RNA-seq data sets GSE118446, comprising seven-day IL-1l{beta}/TGF-{beta}2-treated human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) and human pulmonary arterial endothelial cells, and GSE342578, comprising three-day TGF-{beta}1/2/3-treated HUVECs; single-cell RNA-seq data set GSE237895, comprising seven-day TGF-{beta}1-treated and SNAI1-overexpressing HUVECs; and endothelial cell and cancer-associated fibroblast populations from human metastatic melanoma single-cell RNA-seq data set GSE72056. Results: In GSE118446, EndoMT UP was positively enriched and EndoMT DOWN negatively enriched in chronically IL-1{beta}/TGF-{beta}2-treated endothelial cells, concordant with experimentally validated EndoMT induction, while partial EndoMT-associated enrichment was detected in single ligand-treatment. In contrast, EndoMT UP was negatively enriched following acute TGF-{beta}1/2/3 treatment, suggesting temporal differences between acute TGF-{beta} stimulation and chronic EndoMT induction. In GSE237895 mesenchymal-like endothelial cells, EndoMT UP was positively enriched and EndoMT DOWN negatively enriched in both TGF-{beta}1-treated and SNAI1-overexpressing models. EndoMT gene sets also discriminated endothelial and mesenchymal/stromal transcriptional states in GSE72056 metastatic melanoma. Marker subtype and Gene Ontology Biological Process analyses provided additional exploratory resolution of EndoMT-associated components beyond MSigDB Hallmark EMT. Discussion: The EndoMT R package provides a dedicated, accessible and interoperable resource for EndoMT-focused transcriptomic enrichment analysis. Benchmarking demonstrates utility for detecting established, partial and divergent EndoMT-associated states, supporting broad applicability across EndoMT biology research.

papers.title: methylTFR: Computational quantification of transcription factor activity from DNA methylation
papers.abstract: DNA methylation modulates transcription factor (TF) binding, and plays an important role in regulating gene expression. We developed methylTFR, an R package for quantifying TF activity from DNA methylation across TF-binding sites, providing a low-dimensional and interpretable activity profile. Across 147 human immune cell methylomes, methylTFR identified cell-type-specific regulators, including CEBP and ETS family activity in myeloid cells. In CD4+ T cells, TF activity scores resolved the naive-to-memory trajectory and highlighted AP-1 factors as important memory regulators. We applied methylTFR to sparse single-cell methylome data, and we integrated derived activity scores with gene expression and accessibility into joint factor models yielding multimodal views of lineage regulators.
papers.titleZh: methylTFR：從 DNA 甲基化計算量化轉錄因子活性

papers.title: Scalable and semi-automated Boolean network inference from multi-condition single-cell transcriptomes with scBOLT
papers.abstract: Predictive logical models have made substantial contributions to biomedical research by facilitating the identification of regulatory mechanisms driving biological processes. Yet, their construction remains a major bottleneck, as it typically relies on extensive prior knowledge at the genome scale. The emergence of high-throughput omics technologies has opened new opportunities for data-driven logical model construction by providing high-resolution observations of biological states. In parallel, formal constraint-based approaches have emerged, reformulating executable model inference as a constraint-satisfaction problem. However, transforming omics observations into biologically meaningful Boolean state abstractions and dynamical constraints suitable for logical synthesis engines remains challenging, particularly for poorly understood biological systems and multi-condition experimental settings. To address these challenges, we introduce scBOLT, a semi-automated framework for Boolean constraint engineering and logical model inference from multi-condition single-cell transcriptomes. Beyond these methodological contributions, scBOLT substantially improves computational tractability, enabling the inference of Boolean networks comprising several hundred components within practical runtimes.
papers.titleZh: 利用 scBOLT 從多條件單細胞轉錄組進行可擴展且半自動的布林網路推斷

papers.title: Mucosal architecture, microbiota resilience and metabolic disruption reveal holobiont dynamics during bovine respiratory disease
papers.abstract: The gut-airway axis is increasingly recognised as an important determinant of respiratory health in livestock. However, the interactions among respiratory infections, microbial communities, mucosal barrier function, and microbial metabolism that underpin this axis remain poorly understood. Here, we combined longitudinal immunological, mucosal, microbiological, and metabolic analyses to characterise host-microbiota interactions during antibiotic treatment and experimental bovine respiratory disease (BRD). We found that the bovine respiratory tract is organised as a hierarchically structured mucosal ecosystem, with compartment-specific mucin expression patterns associated with distinct microbial communities. Within this framework, increasing respiratory pathogen loads were associated with greater clinical severity, oxidative stress, acute inflammation, and targeted alterations in mucosal regulation and microbial composition, while serum amyloid A emerged as the host biomarker most closely reflecting infection intensity. Although infection altered host and microbial states, antimicrobial treatment represented the dominant ecological perturbation. Antibiotic exposure reshaped both respiratory and intestinal microbial communities, reducing diversity, increasing community drift, and driving coordinated ecological transitions across the gut-airway axis that exceeded the effects of infection alone. Importantly, these compositional changes were accompanied by profound reductions in acetate, propionate, butyrate, and valerate, identifying short-chain fatty acids as a major functional consequence of gut microbiota disruption. Integrative multi-omics analyses revealed that mucosal organisation, microbial diversity, microbial metabolism, and immune activity were embedded within a highly structured gut-airway network. Together, these findings support a holobiont view of BRD in which disease outcomes emerge not only from pathogen-host interactions but also from ecological disturbances that propagate across interconnected mucosal compartments. Notably, antimicrobial treatment affected ecosystem structure and function more than infection itself, highlighting potential trade-offs between pathogen control and microbiota stability. Preserving microbial resilience and its metabolic functions may therefore represent an important component of future strategies to improve respiratory health and disease resilience in cattle.
papers.titleZh: 黏膜結構、微生物群韌性與代謝紊亂揭示牛呼吸道疾病期間的共生體動態

papers.title: Matched primary-metastasis single-nucleus and spatial profiling of leiomyosarcoma identifies antigen-presenting fibroblasts at the tumor-organ interface
papers.abstract: Leiomyosarcoma is an aggressive soft tissue sarcoma that metastasizes preferentially to lung and liver. Because matched primary and metastatic specimens are rarely available, the cellular changes that accompany metastatic progression remain poorly defined. Here we combined single-nucleus RNA sequencing of archival FFPE tissue from four matched primary-metastasis pairs (two lung, two liver metastases; 48,941 nuclei) with imaging-based spatial transcriptomics of an extended tissue microarray cohort of 21 patients (69 cores, 313,218 cells). Malignant cells, not assignable from transcriptomic references alone, were defined by inferred copy number profiles that were concordant with matched DNA methylation arrays and confirmed the clonal origin of each metastasis. Malignant metaprograms were organ-associated, with a stress- and hypoxia-associated program enriched in lung metastases and a proliferative, matrix-remodeling program enriched in liver metastases. Antigen-presenting cancer-associated fibroblasts (apCAFs) were enriched in metastases relative to matched primaries. This shift was reproduced in the spatial cohort (p = 0.001), where apCAFs formed a discrete band at the tumor-organ interface between malignant cells and adjacent parenchyma, whereas they were sparse and randomly distributed in primary tumors. Spatial transcriptomics further resolved the malignant compartment into three histomolecular phenotypes: (i) smooth-muscle-like with myxoid features, (ii) GPNMB with anaplastic features, and (iii) PDGFRB with vessel-rich stroma, each with a concordant immunohistochemical (-SMA, GPNMB, PDGFRB) and morphological correlate. Together, our data provide a matched primary-metastasis reference for leiomyosarcoma, identify apCAFs as a spatially organized, metastasis-associated stromal population, and delineate histomolecular phenotypes recognizable by routine immunohistochemistry, including a GPNMB phenotype potentially amenable to GPNMB-directed therapies.
papers.titleZh: 配對原發與轉移性平滑肌肉瘤單核與空間分析鑑定腫瘤-器官介面之抗原呈現纖維母細胞

papers.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals tumour cell-intrinsic and microenvironmental features associated with survival in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma
papers.abstract: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC) is the most common form of ovarian carcinoma and accounts for the majority of deaths from the disease, with fewer than half of patients surviving five years after diagnosis. Bulk transcriptomic profiling has identified molecular subtypes and gene-expression signatures associated with shorter or longer survival. However, because bulk profiling measures a composite of tumour and microenvironmental gene expression, the cellular origins of these signatures and their relationship to the tumour microenvironment remain unresolved. To address this, we applied Xenium spatial transcriptomics to treatment-naive HGSOC tumours from 122 patients using a custom 480-gene panel designed to measure tumour-intrinsic gene expression and distinguish immune and stromal cell populations in the surrounding microenvironment. Analysis of tumour-intrinsic gene expression identified 61 genes nominally associated with overall survival, from which Elastic-Net modelling prioritised five genes associated with longer survival and nine associated with shorter survival. Notably, 46 of the 61 associations did not reach the nominal significance threshold when expression was instead aggregated across all cells from the same patients, highlighting how whole-tissue expression can obscure tumour-cell-specific survival associations. Complementary analysis of tumour-proximal cell populations revealed that multiple immune populations were associated with longer survival, whereas two fibroblast populations were associated with shorter survival. Integrating these analyses revealed that survival-associated tumour-intrinsic gene expression was correlated with the abundance of neighbouring immune and stromal populations that were themselves associated with survival. Pairwise Cox regression demonstrated substantial overlap in the prognostic information captured by these features, while analysis of individual gene-cell combinations showed that survival associations differed according to the abundance of neighbouring populations. Consensus clustering further identified four patient groups with distinct combinations of tumour-intrinsic expression and microenvironmental composition, broadly separating patients with longer and shorter survival. Together, this cohort-scale spatial analysis identifies tumour-intrinsic and microenvironmental features associated with HGSOC survival and reveals how their correlated patterns and combined associations relate to patient outcome.
papers.titleZh: 空間轉錄體學揭示高級漿液性卵巢癌存活相關之腫瘤細胞內在與微環境特徵

papers.title: Mechanistic Decoding of Pharmacodynamic Intratumoral Heterogeneity: A Pan-Cancer Regulatory Framework
papers.abstract: Intratumoral heterogeneity (ITH) drives therapy failure through divergent drug response propensities among coexisting subclones - a phenomenon we term pharmacodynamic intratumoral heterogeneity (PharmITH). While single-cell technologies have catalogued transcriptional heterogeneity, which molecular programs shape differential drug responses remains unresolved. Here we decode PharmITH by linking single-cell transcriptomes from 1,279 samples across 24 cancer types with drug-response profiles for 1,218 compounds. We identify 425 hub genes consistently associated with predicted treatment-response heterogeneity and with potential therapeutic relevance and perform multi-omics network analysis in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) integrating transcriptional regulation, somatic mutations, cell-cell communication (CCC), and alternative splicing. This analysis identifies four classes of candidate regulatory associations observed in the LUAD case study: 3 transcription factors establishing pre-existing drug-response programs, 41 genomic alterations amplifying pathway signaling through intermediate networks, 5 ligand-receptor pairs coupling microenvironmental cues to intracellular circuits, and 8 genes producing opposing isoforms via differential splicing. These findings converge on 6 core pathways, revealing that PharmITH arises from tumor-intrinsic mechanisms. Experimental validation and an online platform PharmITH for pan-cancer therapy enable state-resolved drug-response analysis and candidate-gene exploration. This approach transforms ITH from descriptive phenotyping to mechanistic dissection, providing actionable targets to overcome therapy resistance.

papers.title: Metabolic rewiring induces a viral mimicry-mediated quiescence in glioblastoma
papers.abstract: Glioblastoma is a highly aggressive brain tumour driven by therapy-resistant glioblastoma stem cells (GSCs) that switch between dormant and proliferative states through poorly defined programs. In this study, we identify SAT1, encoding the rate-limiting polyamine-catabolic enzyme SSAT1, as enriched in quiescent GSCs, linking metabolic rewiring to dormancy. Pharmacologic induction of SSAT1 with the polyamine analogue N1,N11-Diethylnorspermine (DENSpm) triggers a chemoprotective, reversible growth arrest in patient-derived GSCs, independent of stemness, differentiation or senescence. SAT1-induced dormancy coincides with reduced eIF5A hypusination and global protein translation, and a marked rise in double-stranded RNA that activates type I interferon signalling. Knocking down the mitochondrial antiviral-signalling protein, essential for antiviral innate immunity, partially reverses this growth arrest, establishing viral mimicry as functionally required for dormancy. Single-cell and cohort analyses across GSCs and neural stem cells demonstrate that susceptibility to metabolically induced quiescence is set by an intrinsic inflammatory tone and lysosomal dependency, defining a context-dependent metabolic-immune axis which can be targeted to prevent GBM progression.

papers.title: PWK genetic background reprograms heterochromatin and malignant epithelial states in Neu-driven mammary tumors
papers.abstract: Genetic background can alter the latency and behavior of cancers initiated by the same oncogenic driver, but how inherited variation reshapes the regulatory landscape that permits tumor development remains poorly understood. The PWK genetic background accelerates mammary tumor onset in the NeuT model. We compared PWK NeuT and BALB NeuT tumors using tumor-level RNA-seq, histone ChIP-seq, and single-cell multiome profiling. PWK tumors exhibited broad transcriptional reprogramming characterized by reduced immune-associated expression and increased epithelial differentiation and neuronal-like programs. Chromatin remodeling was spatially redistributed rather than uniformly increased or decreased. PWK tumors showed expansion of H3K9me3- and H4K20me3-associated chromatin, while both marks were depleted across many expressed genes and concentrated within selected intergenic and repeat-rich territories, revealing coordinated redistribution of constitutive heterochromatin. Single-cell multiome profiling showed that broad epithelial representation remained similar between strains, yet specific malignant states were strongly strain biased. Integrated RNA and accessibility analyses identified concordant strain-selective regulatory programs and candidate loci, while trajectory analysis revealed distinct epithelial state transitions between PWK NeuT and BALB NeuT tumors. Together, these findings indicate that inherited genetic background reshapes transcriptional programs, heterochromatin organization, and malignant epithelial state trajectories in NeuT mammary tumors, providing a regulatory framework for understanding strain-dependent differences in tumor onset.

papers.title: Epigenetic regulators partition the genome by evolutionary and developmental constraint
papers.abstract: Many epigenetic regulators play essential roles in animal development, but precisely how they function across different cell types without clear sequence preferences remains a foundational challenge. Here, we employed single-cell RNA sequencing to survey the mutant phenotypes of 30 essential regulatory pathways across over 450 gastrulation stage mouse embryo replicates, including essential factors associated with repressive chromatin states, RNA surveillance/processing, and other genomic roles. We then use this integrated manifold to partition mutant responses into a developmentally-resolved interaction network, revealing a hierarchy of heterochromatin-associated interactions that act orthogonally to Polycomb Repressive Complex-mediated control of embryo patterning. Compared to the embryo proper, we find that the developing placenta and yolk sac can accommodate broad swings in repetitive element expression, a resilience in keeping with the relative evolutionary recency and phenotypic plasticity of these tissues. Dense temporal sampling of Human Silencing Hub (HUSH) mutant embryogenesis further supports the notion that the gastrulating embryo is particularly constrained and depends on multiple layers of insulation, including the need to suppress evolutionarily young genetic elements to stably license highly conserved, phylotypic programs. In combination, our work highlights the power of single cell-resolved developmental genetics to contextualize the roles of epigenetic regulators, which restrict genomic action to support robust cellular identities and embryological forms.

papers.title: Large-scale proteomics identifies circulating markers of pulmonary pressure and pulmonary hypertension risk
papers.abstract: By integrating proteomics, genetics and imaging, this study identifies candidate blood biomarkers of pulmonary hypertension, implicates NOTCH3 in disease development, and defines distinct biological subtypes of individuals at risk for this condition.
papers.titleZh: 大規模蛋白體學找出肺壓與肺動脈高壓風險的循環標記
papers.summaryZh: 本研究整合蛋白體學、遺傳學與影像資料，鑑定出與肺動脈高壓相關的候選血液生物標記。研究指出 NOTCH3 與疾病發展有關，並據此定義出風險族群中的不同生物學亞型。這些發現為肺動脈高壓的風險評估提供可能的循環指標方向。

papers.title: Ghd7‑triggered transcriptional regulation for synergistically improving rice eating quality and yield
papers.abstract: Rice breeders struggle to boost yield and eating quality simultaneously as the two traits often work against each other. Here, the authors identify a CCT domain transcription regulator encoding gene Ghd7 in determining rice grain amylose content and functioning in balancing starch and protein to coordinate yield and quality.
papers.titleZh: 由 Ghd7 觸發的轉錄調控，可協同改善水稻的食味品質與產量
papers.summaryZh: 水稻育種者往往難以同時提升產量與食味品質，因為這兩個特質常互相衝突。本研究識別出編碼 CCT 領域轉錄調節因子的 Ghd7 基因，其能決定稻米的直鏈澱粉含量，並在平衡澱粉與蛋白質以協調產量和品質方面發揮作用。這項發現有助於突破以往難以兼顧稻米產量與品質的困境。

papers.title: PSHIC reveals allele-specific chromatin organization by phasing-free structural modeling
papers.abstract: PSHIC reconstructs parent-specific 3D genome organization from standard Hi-C data without phased genetic variants. It outperforms existing methods and recovers validated features of X inactivation, imprinting and gene regulation.
papers.titleZh: 無需分相即可重建等位基因特異性染色質三維結構
papers.summaryZh: PSHIC 是一種從標準 Hi-C 資料重建親本特異性三維基因組結構的方法，且不需要分相的遺傳變異。研究指出該方法相較於現有方法表現更佳。PSHIC 能恢復已驗證的 X 染色體失活、印記以及基因調控特徵。

papers.title: Reframing decentralized diagnostics with a programmable multi-dimensional microfluidic system
papers.abstract: Decentralized diagnostics has the potential to improve health equity as well as support a more rapid response to disease outbreaks. Here authors present SID-WAVES, a multimodal microfluidic platform which allows ‘sample-in, results-out’ detection of both nucleic acid and protein biomarkers.

papers.title: TransGram for heterogeneity-aware transcriptome reconstruction from long read RNA-Seq data
papers.abstract: Long-read RNA sequencing datasets exhibit heterogeneity that affects transcript reconstruction. Here, the authors characterize this heterogeneity and develop TransGram, which adapts reconstruction to different data types to improve accuracy.

Coordination ring-opening transamidation copolymerization of cyclic lactones and lactams towards circular and biodegradable poly(ester amide) adhesives
paper.abstract: The direct copolymerization of lactones and lactams to produce poly(ester amide)s is a challenge. Here, the authors report the titanium catalyzed ring-opening transamidation polymerization of ε-caprolactone and ε-caprolactam to produce biodegradable poly(ester amide)s with good adhesive properties.

paper.title: Narrowing urban heat disparities alongside faster greening in low-income neighborhoods across cities in the United States
paper.abstract: This study finds that heat disparities between high- and low-income neighborhoods narrowed across 55 U.S. cities from 1986 to 2020, alongside faster greening in disadvantaged neighborhoods, although substantial inequalities persisted.
